table/glossary.entries.arms.body.0.en: An extending arm uses data at the current cell to determine how far to reach. It can read beyond the usual view.
table/glossary.entries.arms.body.0.zh: 伸缩臂按当前格的数据决定要读多远，可以够到视野以外的格子。

table/glossary.entries.arms.body.1.en: Select a cell in reach to add its output port to the view part.
table/glossary.entries.arms.body.1.zh: 在视野中选中伸缩臂够到的格子，就会给视野元件增加相应的输出口。

table/glossary.entries.sweep.body.0.en: A sweep arm sends the values of a whole range of cells to the board.
table/glossary.entries.sweep.body.0.zh: 扫描臂把一段格子的数一起送到电路板。

table/glossary.entries.sweep.body.1.en: Parts that accept a range as input can receive these thicker wires.
table/glossary.entries.sweep.body.1.zh: 需要整段输入的元件可以接收这样的粗线。
